parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Export scope: all (ignore filters), filtered (apply current filters/search/sort), current_page (rows on the current page), selected (specific IDs via the ids parameter)

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated column keys to include. Allowed: id, inventory_movement_date, sku, product_name, type, inventory_status, quantity, warehouse, layer, reference, source, link_type, link_id, fifo_layer_id, created_at, updated_at. Omit to export all columns.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated inventory movement IDs. Required only when scope=selected.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search by ID, SKU, product name, warehouse name, or reference (when scope=filtered)

parameters.name: filter[inventory_status]
parameters.description: Filter by inventory status: active, in_transit (when scope=filtered)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for DESC. Allowed: id, inventory_movement_date, quantity, type, inventory_status, reference, warehouse_name, sku, product_name, created_at, updated_at
